title: Council Configuration
description: Full configuration file for the council protocol (providers array + settings).

providers.description: List of LLM providers to consult.

gateway.description: Route all non-local providers through an OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway. When set, each provider call is dispatched through the gateway provider with the shared api_base/api_key; the per-provider `provider` field is treated as a label.

api_base.description: Gateway base URL. Falls back to the GATEWAY_API_BASE environment variable when omitted.

api_key.description: Gateway API key or ${ENV_VAR} reference. Falls back to the GATEWAY_API_KEY environment variable when omitted.
